name: London
seaSeedNote: Mid-Thames off the Isle of Dogs, where the river is at its widest inside the grid. London has no sea within reach, so the flood is seeded in the river itself — which works because OSM maps the TIDAL Thames banks as natural=coastline all the way up to Teddington.
note: THE THAMES READS +8 m IN THE COARSE DATA — as land. Without a mask the river is a field and the city has no shape at all, which is the same fault New York's East River had. Bridges matter more here than anywhere: Tower Bridge, London Bridge, Westminster and Waterloo are the crossings the skyline is read against.
coastBboxNote: Sized to the MASK GRID plus 2.5 km, not by eye. The flood fill only reads coastline inside the grid; the margin exists so it cannot walk around the ends of the shore at the boundary. The first version of this box was three times larger, which at one Overpass tile every three minutes is hours spent fetching open ocean nobody will ever see.
